description: Search gate denied valid agentgrep record searches, leaving lazy-harness Jcode edit/write hooks stricter than the tool set used by Jcode agents.
reproSteps: Run on-tool-execute-before payload for edit/write with recent_tool_calls containing agentgrep and args_preview pointing at .lazy-harness/decisions; expected allow and session cache creation, not force-gate deny.

description: Jcode lifecycle hooks emitted plain text, causing invalid hook decision JSON errors when response.completed or tool.execute.before produced gate output.
reproSteps: Trigger response.completed with a helper that returns STOP text; before fix Jcode logs invalid hook decision JSON, after fix hook stdout is valid JSON with inject/body. Trigger tool.execute.before deny; stdout must be valid JSON action=deny with reason.

description: Host sync manifest briefly copied framework ADR 0028 into host decisions, breaking host ADR contiguity checks because Medivance received only 0028 without 0001~0027.
reproSteps: Sync lazy-harness to Medivance with decisions/0028-progressive-knowledge-graph-backbone.md listed as Category A, then run .lazy-harness/bin/lazy test; before fix D03 reports missing ADR numbers 1~27, after fix framework ADR 0028 is not copied to host decisions and host lazy test passes.

description: Active lazy-harness TypeScript scripts could hide explicit any types when installed into Medivance because the host lint temporarily ignored .lazy-harness/**, allowing framework code quality regressions to escape app lint gates.
reproSteps: Run grep for explicit any in active lazy-harness scripts before the fix; host-pilot.ts reports records:any[] and entry as any casts. After the fix the grep returns no matches and framework self-test passes.

description: Search/read-debt gates could false-positive when Jcode omitted prior Read/agentgrep calls from lifecycle recent_tool_calls even though tool.execute.after had logged the evidence.
reproSteps: Create a correlated Context Delivery packet requiring read/search evidence, leave lifecycle recent_tool_calls empty, and add same-message/session Read or agentgrep rows to .jcode/hooks/tool-events.jsonl. Before fix the pre-action permit/audit still denied; after fix it accepts the logged evidence. Hardening fixtures also ensure different-message same-session and pre-packet logs do not satisfy the gate.

description: Search-debt context must not rely on automatic Context Delivery/relevant-record helper output, blind guessed-string queries, tool-specific allowlists, or shell/CLI user-text semantic classifiers. The message.received hook must be a static transport: pass harness map/index/file inventory and search guidance, journal sanitized generic debt, and let the LLM/searcher understand user intent.
reproSteps: Trigger message.received with two different non-empty user messages such as 안녕 and 기능패널 고쳐줘. Before the fix the hook could choose silence or self-resolve-before-change/answer by regex over raw text. After the fix both non-empty messages emit the same static harness-first inventory/search body with instructionLevel harness-first-static, no raw message is stored, and action remains blocked until root-bound harness-following inventory/search/read evidence exists.

description: Legacy pre-action search-performed helper could false-deny Edit after valid harness-first evidence because nested batch reads and brace-style record search were not recognized, while apply_patch or namespaced apply_patch could bypass the same no-search source-edit gate.
reproSteps: Run on-tool-execute-before with Edit targeting src/*.tsx and recent_tool_calls containing either bash grep over .lazy-harness/{domain,spec,behavior,tests,decisions,ssot}/ or batch nested Read calls for .lazy-harness records; before fix the hook denied, after fix it allows. Run apply_patch or functions.apply_patch targeting src/*.ts with no recent search; before fix it bypassed, after fix it denies.

description: response.completed compare-mode dogfood reported mismatches caused by instrumentation fidelity gaps: trailing newline hashing drift, missing sandbox git facts, missing bounded runtime state, and missing correlated tool-event context.
reproSteps: Before d5eba94c5600, collect response.completed compare-mode rows on dogfood hosts after helpers emit trailing-newline output or depend on git/runtime state; lazy lifecycle-compare-summary reports non-zero mismatches. After the fix, fresh Medivance, Medivance PWA, and Medivance homepage smoke logs report rows=1, mismatches=0, failures=0 with class match-after-normalization:trailing-newline.

description: self-test.py inherited Git hook environment variables such as GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE, and GIT_COMMON_DIR into temp git fixtures and helper subprocesses, allowing nested fixture commands to resolve or mutate the outer repository configuration such as core.bare.
protectedBy: .lazy-harness/bin/lazy test --scope framework under poisoned external git env
reproSteps: Create an external temporary git repo, set GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_INDEX_FILE/GIT_COMMON_DIR to that repo while LAZY_HOST_ROOT points at the lazy-harness source, then run .lazy-harness/bin/lazy test --scope framework. Before the fix, nested self-test git fixtures could inherit the outer git env; after the fix, the test passes and source core.bare/core.worktree stay unchanged.

description: Phase 5/6 self-tests incorrectly required the framework-source lazy-evidence-capsule capability on downstream hosts, even though capabilities.json is host-owned and may omit that source-only registry entry.
reproSteps: Copy synced Phase 5/6 framework files into a host whose .lazy-harness/ssot/capabilities.json omits lazy-evidence-capsule, then run focused self-test checks. Before 2d2439d they fail or require the source capability; after 2d2439d host scope passes and validates the capability only when present.
